title: Cubist Portrait
description: A bold cubist interpretation of the feminine form, layered with newspaper fragments and warm earth pigments.
story: This piece was born from my fascination with how we see faces — not as flat images, but as shifting planes of light. Each fragment carries a different perspective, like memories stacked upon each other. The newspaper text whispers stories from another era, grounding the abstract forms in reality.

title: Golden Minarets
description: An architectural mosaic celebrating Islamic geometry, golden domes rising through tessellated desert light.
story: Walking through the old city, the minarets catch the last golden hour light differently each evening. I wanted to capture not a single view, but the accumulated impression of thousands of glances upward — each tessera a snapshot of sky and stone and prayer.

title: Still Life Window
description: A still life scene with candles, fruit, and flowers arranged on a table before a window revealing a stylized landscape.
story: في اللوحة دي، حاولت ألملم تفاصيل اللحظة اللي بتتجمع فيها أشياء بسيطة حوالينا: ورد في فازة، شوية فواكه، وضوء ناعم بيغمر الطاولة الخشبية. الألوان والخطوط بتتداخل عشان تحكي حكاية هدوء ودفء بيتخلل المكان.

title: Flowing Form
description: An abstract, freeform shape with flowing swaths of blue, brown, and beige blending softly across a white background.

title: Blue Geode
description: An abstract mixed media piece resembling a geode with swirling blue and grey hues, accented by textured gold edges and a central gold-lined void.

title: Colored Fragments
description: A stained glass-like composition of irregularly shaped fragments in shades of blue, purple, brown, and teal, separated by bold gold lines, set against a black background.

title: Sunset
description: A textured epoxy painting with marble stones, crystals, and acrylics. The lower part is rough with earth and clay textures, rising with marble and crystals, while the upper part is clear epoxy representing the sky and clouds at sunset.
story: I called this piece Sunset because I wanted to capture the earth's layers as if I was sculpting the texture with a palette knife. The bottom shows earth and clay textures, with marble and crystals emerging upwards, while the top is a clear epoxy sky. The clouds form as the sun sets, casting shades of sunset colors across the scene.

title: Blue Geode
description: An abstract mixed media piece resembling a geode slice with swirling shades of turquoise, teal, and gray, bordered by textured white and gold edges.

title: Resin Chess Set
medium: Cast resin, pigment and gold leaf
description: A handmade chess set with translucent blue and white resin pieces, some accented with gold leaf, arranged on a textured blue and white resin board with uneven edges.

title: Abstract Faces
description: A large vertical composition filled with abstracted faces and eyes in a limited palette of blue, black, white, and orange, with bold black outlines and geometric shapes.

title: Petals in Relief
description: Sculpted petals and leaf forms built up in thick relief, curling out of a pale swirl on the left into deep navy and teal on the right.

title: Figure with a Heron
description: A tall stylised figure in black with round white spectacles and a crescent moon at the crown, set against harlequin diamonds in blue and green, with a blue heron standing in front. It now hangs, backlit, in a lounge.

title: Autumn Leaves
medium: Mixed media: crystal, mirror, gold leaf
description: Feathered leaves in gold, grey and rose mirrored about the centre of a black ground, with clusters of crystal and mirror shards falling between them and gold leaf along their edges.

title: The Dome of the Rock in Spring
description: The Dome of the Rock under a bright spring sky, framed by pink and white blossom, with people crossing the stone courtyard and a girl wheeling a bicycle in the foreground.

title: Black Horse
description: A black horse galloping towards the viewer out of a black ground, its mane streaming, picked out in silver, white and touches of gold.

title: The Golden Tree
description: A gold tree twisting up out of a dark green forest of layered trunks and leaves, its branches dissolving into a flock of small gold birds beneath a full gold moon.

title: Blue Geode Diptych
description: Two panels that meet in the middle to make one geode: bands of deep blue resin, white crystal and gold curving out from the seam.

title: White Bloom
description: A white flower in thick relief on a round black canvas, its petals edged in gold and its centre raised in gold stamens.

title: Roses, Violin and Candles
description: A classical still life on a dark ground: pink roses in a glass vase, a lit three-branch candelabra, and a violin with a quill and sealed letter on the table, set into a carved moulded wall panel.

title: Birds on a Gold Branch
description: Flowering branches and two small blue birds painted over a burnished gold ground, set into an ornate moulded wall panel above a pair of gilded chairs.

title: Gold Leaf Abstract
description: A tall abstract of broad sweeping strokes in bronze, cream and silver, crossed by a band of crackled gold leaf.

title: Blue and Gold
description: A wide abstract of heavy palette-knife strokes in navy, gold and cream sweeping diagonally across the canvas, framed in black and hung above a bed.

title: Gold Crescent
description: A burnished gold half-disc with a polished curled edge, raised off a white square panel, hung on a plastered wall above a sofa.

title: Black Geode
description: A geode in black and silver: veins of crushed crystal and glass running diagonally across a poured black and pewter resin ground, edged in silver.

title: The Tree of Palestine
description: Olive wood carved in the outline of Palestine, with a white dove at the top, the Dome of the Rock, a keffiyeh pattern, Kufic lettering in gold across the surface, and a channel filled with green epoxy resin.

title: Ronaldo
description: A footballer seen from behind in a white number 7 shirt, arms spread in celebration against a stormy grey sky.

title: Gold Leaves
description: Grey and white strokes drawn down the canvas over a block of black, crossed by a diagonal trail of raised gold leaves, with gold leaf flecked into the top corners.

title: Black Bloom
description: A pleated black ring around a pale textured centre, raised off a square black panel and hung on a white marble wall.

title: Line Figure
description: A seated figure drawn in a single continuous raised line in rose gold on a charcoal board.

title: Red Rose
description: A single red rose opening out of a black ground, its petals built up in dry, glowing strokes of red.

title: Gold and Blue, a Pair
medium: Mixed media with gold leaf, two pieces
description: Two small abstracts in gold frames, one in grey and white with gold leaf, the other with a sweep of deep blue, hung side by side above a sofa.

title: Two Cars
description: A pair of panels, each with a die-cast car fixed to the surface: a black off-roader on ochre beside a burst of white paint, and a black saloon on a red and black field splashed with blue and black.

title: Resin Clock
description: A round wall clock in poured resin: cream marbled with gold, two teal corners edged in green and clear glass, a seam of gold crystal across the middle, and gold Roman numerals.
